spec: COMPREHENSIVE_PLAN_FOR_REAL_TIME_WRIGHT_FLYER_SIM_WITH_FRANKENSIM.md (ROUND 6 steady state), E1.4; sibling of geometry-conventions-v1 (E1.9)

body_axes.definition: right-handed body frame Fixed to the airframe: +x forward along the longitudinal datum, +y toward the RIGHT wingtip, +z DOWN (standard flight-dynamics FRD)
body_axes.handedness: right (x cross y = z, machine-checked by the battery)
body_axes.origin: the CG REFERENCE POINT of the mass build-up (a declared point on the airframe datum, NOT the instantaneous CG — the instantaneous CG offset is state)
body_axes.world_frame: NED (north-east-down) at the site anchor; the FlatnessCertificate plane defines local level
body_axes.quaternion: unit quaternion (w, x, y, z), BODY-to-WORLD rotation (matches fs-flyer-wasm HelloState)

moment_signs.moment_reference: moments about the CG reference point; pitch reference length = mean chord c; roll/yaw reference length = full span b (geometry-conventions-v1 symbols)
moment_signs.note: matches the Culick/Jex flight-dynamics literature so V-02a pole/derivative comparisons need no sign flips; any dataset in a different convention is re-expressed at ingest, never at comparison time

angle_conventions.alpha: angle of attack, positive nose-up relative to the free-stream velocity projected in the body x-z plane [rad in code, deg in UI]
angle_conventions.units_rule: radians in ALL code and stored artifacts; degrees only at the presentation boundary (fs-qty enforces)

control_signs.doctrine: control-surface signs are defined by their COMMANDED MOMENT at trim, not by geometry; the geometric realization (which edge moves which way) is E1.5 dossier territory and is recorded alongside, never load-bearing
control_signs.canard_dc: positive canard command produces POSITIVE pitch moment (nose up)
control_signs.warp_dw: positive warp command produces POSITIVE roll moment (right wing down)
control_signs.rudder_dr: positive rudder command produces POSITIVE yaw moment (nose right); 1903 configuration: dr = 2.5 * dw SLAVED (flyer-reference rudder_warp_slaving) — the sign pairing is chosen so the slaving counters adverse yaw (positive warp command yields positive dr)
control_signs.trace_rule: InputTraceV1 quantized_value stores the COMMAND in these sign conventions; transducer geometry lives in InputPolicyId

instruments.wrights-hand-richard: the Wrights' hand-held Richard anemometer ('a little over 20 miles, corrected' — Orville diary, Dec 17)
instruments.government-weather-bureau: the Kitty Hawk Weather Bureau instrument (27 mph at the first flight per the diary; 24-27 over the flights per the 1913 account)
instruments.modeled: simulation-generated wind statistics (fs-atmo), which must cite the height and averaging interval explicitly

wind_reference.unrecorded_rule: heights and averaging intervals for BOTH 1903 instruments are UNRECORDED: height_m is null with a declared prior (hand-held ~1.5-2 m; station exposure unknown, prior 3-10 m), never a silent point value
wind_reference.dec17_doctrine: the Dec-17 wind is a DISTRIBUTION spanning instruments and their unknown heights under the log-law (flyer-reference wind_dec17_mps + sand_roughness_z0_m); H-case ensembles draw from it; no single mph number is ever 'the' wind

uncertainty_doctrine.digitization: geometry digitized from drawings/photos carries a per-source digitization class: drawings ±2-5 mm at scale, photo-inference (e.g. canard travel) is absent-by-verification per flyer-reference and enters as a model-uncertainty axis, never a measured value
uncertainty_doctrine.historical_inputs: historical-input distributions live in PhysicalScenarioId (wind, pilot mass 145 lb single-source, engine power 12-16 hp thermal transient); model deficiencies live in ModelUncertaintyRealizationId — the separation is the frozen identity law (replay-identity-schema-v1)
uncertainty_doctrine.coherent_draws: uncertainty is realized as COHERENT DRAWS bound to realization ids; per-query independent intervals are forbidden (E4.0 contract inherits this)
uncertainty_doctrine.variant_rule: where flyer-reference records variants (engine mass, rudder area, derrick), the variant set IS the support of the input distribution; deleting a variant requires a source, not a preference

dataset_reexpression_rule.rule: every ingested A-dataset MUST declare {axes_id, moment_signs_id, angles_id, reference_area_convention, wind_reference} resolving to ids frozen HERE and in geometry-conventions-v1 BEFORE any value enters a fit or gate; ingest without the block is a typed refusal (consumers implement; this artifact is the authority)
dataset_reexpression_rule.reexpressed_now: all 36 flyer-reference values carry convention labels resolving to these ids; the Ames/LFST force-moment TABLES are not yet in-repo — their ingest (E4 lanes) is bound by this rule
dataset_reexpression_rule.identity: this conventions block enters ReplayEnvelopeV1.conventions_block and artifact manifests by content hash; code-side registration lands with the first consumer per register-at-introduction law

no_claims: Conventions only. No physics value is asserted here; values live in flyer-reference.json under these labels.
